Building: Église de la Madeleine, Paris (church).
The front (−z) is the south portico facing the Rue Royale.
Footprint: 43.2 m along x by 128.3 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (approximate: the hull of its OpenStreetMap parts), [x, z] in metres, going round:
[[-21.6,64.2],[-21.6,-64.2],[21.6,-64.2],[21.6,64.2]]
Height: the highest point is 36 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front three-quarter: full peripteral Corinthian colonnade with pediment, daylight
  2. long-side three-quarter along the colonnade with the front pediment at left, daylight
  3. elevated view over the rooftops of the pedimented front and the green-copper pitched roof (low resolution, processed look)

Reply with the JSON object only.

json.notes: Three biggest differences: (1) the columns are too thin and widely spaced, so the peristyle reads as a fence. The real Madeleine has heavy Corinthian columns packed close together, with a deep shadow between them and the cella wall. (2) The front portico lacks its wide flight of steps and its heavy projecting pediment. The render's front triangle is shallow and sits too low. (3) The podium is too thin. The real building stands on a high stepped base, so the columns rise well above the ground. The copper roof and overall length are about right.

final.notes: Three biggest differences: (1) the columns are too thin and widely spaced, so the peristyle reads as a fence. The real Madeleine has heavy Corinthian columns packed close together, with a deep shadow between them and the cella wall. (2) The front portico lacks its wide flight of steps and its heavy projecting pediment. The render's front triangle is shallow and sits too low. (3) The podium is too thin. The real building stands on a high stepped base, so the columns rise well above the ground. The copper roof and overall length are about right.

json.notes: The Madeleine is a peripteral Corinthian temple: a continuous ring of free-standing columns (8 across the front and back, about 26 along each flank) around a blank cella, on a raised stepped podium. The gable roof runs along z with a sculpted pediment on the south front, and it is clad in green copper. I model the ring as colonnades, the cella as a plain stone block, and the roof as a copper gable.
